Demo AI

A small local AI chat that uses a model already available through your browser. No API keys, model-file download, Puter account, or Mac server is used by this project.

▶ Run

A model must already exist on the device

This uses the browser’s built-in LanguageModel API, not Qwen or Dolphin. It starts a session only when the browser reports its model as available. If a model needs downloading, is downloading, or is unsupported, Demo AI leaves chat disabled and explains why.

A local AI cannot run without model files somewhere on the device. Chrome may have installed or downloaded its built-in model independently of this app. Browser version, hardware, policy, language, and platform affect availability; phones and other browsers may not support it.
